policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: Qere הַסְּתָיו and ketiv הסתו are the same noun 'winter' differing only in final mater lectionis; ASV 'the winter is past' renders both identically and carries no note mapped to this unit. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.

Qere לָךְ and ketiv לכי are orthographic variants of the same 2fs imperative of הלך with the ethical dative; both yield 'come away' addressed to the feminine beloved, and ASV 'Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away' has no wording or mapped textual note distinguishing them. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
